arxiv-1912-08479.title: Search for chargino-neutralino production with mass splittings near the electroweak scale in three-lepton final states in s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV p ​ p pp collisions with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-1912-08479.creator: ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-1912-08479.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by ATLAS Collaboration. A search for supersymmetry through the pair production of electroweakinos with mass splittings near the electroweak scale and decaying via on-shell W W and Z Z bosons is presented for a three-lepton final state. The analyzed proton–proton collision data taken at a center-of-mass energy of s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV were collected between 2015 and 2018 by the ATLAS experiment at the Large Hadron Collider, corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 139 fb -1 .

arxiv-2104-14962.title: PSEUDo : Interactive Pattern Search in Multivariate Time Series with Locality-Sensitive Hashing and Relevance Feedback
arxiv-2104-14962.creator: Yuncong Yu, Dylan Kruyff, Tim Becker, Michael Behrisch
arxiv-2104-14962.description: Abstract We present PSEUDo , an adaptive feature learning technique for exploring visual patterns in multi-track sequential data. Our approach is designed with the primary focus to overcome the uneconomic retraining requirements and inflexible representation learning in current deep learning-based systems. Multi-track time series data are generated on an unprecedented scale due to increased sensors and data storage.

arxiv-2305-10987.title: SPENSER: Towards a NeuroEvolutionary Approach for Convolutional Spiking Neural Networks Conference: Genetic and Evolutionary Computation Conference Companion; July 15–19, 2023; Lisbon, Portugal Genetic and Evolutionary Computation Conference Companion (GECCO ’23 Companion), July 15–19, 2023, Lisbon,
arxiv-2305-10987.creator: Henrique Branquinho, Nuno Lourenço, Ernesto Costa
arxiv-2305-10987.description: Abstract . Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have attracted recent interest due to their energy efficiency and biological plausibility. However, the performance of SNNs still lags behind traditional Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs), as there is no consensus on the best learning algorithm for SNNs. Best-performing SNNs are based on ANN to SNN conversion or learning with spike-based backpropagation through surrogate gradients.

arxiv-2306-06341.title: Mapping Molecular Hamiltonians into Hamiltonians of Modular cQED Processors
arxiv-2306-06341.creator: Ningyi Lyu, Alessandro Miano, Ioannis Tsioutsios, Rodrigo Cortiñas, Kenneth Jung, Yuchen Wang, Zixuan Hu, Eitan Geva, Sabre Kais, Victor S. Batista
arxiv-2306-06341.description: Abstract We introduce a general method based on the operators of the Dyson-Masleev transformation to map the Hamiltonian of an arbitrary model system into the Hamiltonian of a circuit Quantum Electrodynamics (cQED) processor. Furthermore, we introduce a modular approach to program a cQED processor with components corresponding to the mapping Hamiltonian.

arxiv-2308-02857.title: Nonequilibrium thermodynamic signatures of collective dynamical states around chimera in a chemical reaction network
arxiv-2308-02857.creator: Premashis Kumar, Gautam Gangopadhyay
arxiv-2308-02857.description: Abstract Different dynamical states ranging from coherent, incoherent to chimera, multichimera, and related transitions are addressed in a globally coupled nonlinear continuum chemical oscillator system by implementing a modified complex Ginzburg-Landau equation. Besides dynamical identifications of observed states using standard qualitative metrics, we systematically acquire nonequilibrium thermodynamic characterizations of these states obtained via coupling parameters.

arxiv-2311-13822.title: Critical temperature and thermodynamic properties of a homogeneous dilute weakly interacting Bose gas within the improved Hartree-Fock approximation at finite temperature
arxiv-2311-13822.creator: Nguyen Van Thu and Pham Duy Thanh
arxiv-2311-13822.description: Abstract By means of Cornwall–Jackiw–Tomboulis effective action approach we investigate a homogeneous dilute weakly interacting Bose gas at finite temperature in vicinity of critical region. A longstanding debate, the shift of critical temperature, is considered and obtained in the universal form Δ ​ T C / T C ( 0 ) = c .

arxiv-2401-09317.title: From Zero-Freeness to Strong Spatial Mixing via a Christoffel-Darboux Type Identity
arxiv-2401-09317.creator: Shuai Shao, Xiaowei Ye
arxiv-2401-09317.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Shuai Shao, Xiaowei Ye. We present a unifying proof to derive the strong spatial mixing (SSM) property for the general 2-spin system from zero-free regions of its partition function. Our proof works for the multivariate partition function over all three complex parameters ( β , γ , λ ) (\beta,\gamma,\lambda) , and we allow the zero-free regions of β , γ \beta,\gamma or λ \lambda to be of arbitrary shapes.

arxiv-2401-16865.title: Depends-Kotlin: A Cross-Language Kotlin Dependency Extractor DOI: 10.1145/xxxxxxx.xxxxxxx Conference: ASE’24: the 39th IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE ’24); October 27 – November 01, 2024; Sacramento, California, USA Proceedings of the 39th IEEE/ACM Internati
arxiv-2401-16865.creator: Qiong Feng, Xiaotian Ma, Huan Ji, Wei Song, Peng Liang
arxiv-2401-16865.description: Abstract . Since Google introduced Kotlin as an official programming language for developing Android apps in 2017, Kotlin has gained widespread adoption in Android development. However, compared to Java, there is limited support for Kotlin code dependency analysis, which is the foundation to software analysis.

arxiv-2404-00834.title: Towards Robust Event-guided Low-Light Image Enhancement: A Large-Scale Real-World Event-Image Dataset and Novel Approach
arxiv-2404-00834.creator: Guoqiang Liang, Kanghao Chen, Hangyu Li, Yunfan Lu, Lin Wang
arxiv-2404-00834.description: Abstract Event camera has recently received much attention for low-light image enhancement (LIE) thanks to their distinct advantages, such as high dynamic range. However, current research is prohibitively restricted by the lack of large-scale, real-world, and spatial-temporally aligned event-image datasets.

arxiv-2407-16221.title: Do LLMs Know When to NOT Answer? Investigating Abstention Abilities of Large Language Models
arxiv-2407-16221.creator: Nishanth Madhusudhan, Sathwik Tejaswi Madhusudhan, Vikas Yadav, Masoud Hashemi
arxiv-2407-16221.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Nishanth Madhusudhan, Sathwik Tejaswi Madhusudhan, Vikas Yadav, Masoud Hashemi. Abstention Ability ( 𝒜 ​ 𝒜 \mathcal{AA} ) is a critical aspect of Large Language Model (LLM) reliability, referring to an LLM’s capability to withhold responses when uncertain or lacking a definitive answer, without compromising performance. Although previous studies have attempted to improve 𝒜 ​ 𝒜 \mathcal{AA} , they lack a standardised evaluation method and remain unsuitable for black-box models where token prediction probabilities are inaccessible.

arxiv-2408-02771.title: Symmetrizing polytopes and posets
arxiv-2408-02771.creator: Federico Castillo, Fu Liu
arxiv-2408-02771.description: Abstract . Motivated by the authors’ work on permuto-associahedra, which can be considered as a symmetrization of the associahedron using the symmetric group, we introduce and study the 𝔊 {\mathfrak{G}} -symmetrization of an arbitrary polytope P P for any reflection group 𝔊 {\mathfrak{G}} .

arxiv-2508-10225.title: Local-global compatibility and the exceptional zero conjecture for GL ⁡ ( 3 ) \operatorname{GL}(3)
arxiv-2508-10225.creator: Daniel Barrera Salazar, Andrew Graham, and Chris Williams
arxiv-2508-10225.description: Abstract . We prove the exceptional zero conjecture of Greenberg–Benois for p p -ordinary regular algebraic cuspidal automorphic representations of GL 3 ⁡ ( 𝔸 ) \operatorname{GL}_{3}(\mathbb{A}) which are Steinberg at p p . In particular, we obtain the first cases of this conjecture for non-essentially-self-dual RACARs of GL n ⁡ ( 𝔸 ) \operatorname{GL}_{n}(\mathbb{A}) .

pmc-11350376.title: Cutting the Gordian knot of diuretic resistance using continuous ultrafiltration in a Holt–Oram patient with decompensated heart failure and Eisenmenger syndrome: a case report
pmc-11350376.creator: Yannis Dimitroglou, Emmanouil Mantzouranis, Christina Chrysohoou, Stella Brili, Konstantinos Tsioufis
pmc-11350376.description: BackgroundContinuous ultrafiltration consists a decongestion method for patients with refractory decompensated heart failure with diuretic resistance as it enables the energetic withdrawal of isotonic fluid under controlled rate according to the patient’s vital signs, offering decongestion without exceeding plasma refill rate.Case summaryA 62-year-old male with history of Holt–Oram syndrome with Eisenmenger physiology presented with worsening dyspnoea.

pmc-11357162.title: Calcium Citrate Amount and Gelatine Source Impact on Hydroxyapatite Formation in Bone Regeneration Material in Simulated Body Fluid
pmc-11357162.creator: Yuejun Wang, Taishi Yokoi, Masaya Shimabukuro, Masakazu Kawashita
pmc-11357162.description: Bone grafting is crucial for bone regeneration. Recent studies have proposed the use of calcium citrate (CC) as a potential graft material. Notably, citrate does not inhibit hydroxyapatite (HAp) formation at specific calcium-to-citrate molar ratios. Octacalcium phosphate (OCP)/gelatine (Gel) composites, which are commonly produced from porcine Gel, are valued for their biodegradability and bone replacement capability.

pmc-11415987.title: The effect of clinical supervision model on nurses’ self-efficacy and communication skills in the handover process of medical and surgical wards: an experimental study
pmc-11415987.creator: Faezeh Gheisari, Sedigheh Farzi, Mohammad Javad Tarrahi, Tahere Momeni-Ghaleghasemi
pmc-11415987.description: BackgroundThe handover process is a vital part of patient safety continuity, particularly conducted between nurses at the end of shifts. Nurses often face challenges in handover due to a lack of self-efficacy and inadequate communication skills. The clinical supervision model, by providing emotional, educational, and organizational support, aids in skill acquisition and instills confidence.

pmc-11428855.title: Examining changes in pain interference via pandemic-induced isolation among patients receiving medication for opioid use disorder: a secondary data analysis
pmc-11428855.creator: Tessa Frohe, Tim Janssen, Bryan R. Garner, Sara J. Becker
pmc-11428855.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundEarly in the pandemic, the United States population experienced a sharp rise in the prevalence rates of opioid use, social isolation, and pain interference. Given the high rates of pain reported by patients on medication for opioid use disorder (MOUD), the pandemic presented a unique opportunity to disentangle the relationship between opioid use, pain, and social isolation in this high-risk population.

pmc-11533012.title: Investigating the impact of lipid oxidation on the duck odorous smell during storage and reheating based on lipidomics
pmc-11533012.creator: Gaiming Zhao, Ying Zhang, Jiali Zhang, Sen Wang, Ke Wang, Long Xu, Qiuhui Zhang, Chaozhi Zhu
pmc-11533012.description: In the actual production of duck meat, the cooking time for marinated and sliced duck products is around 30 min. Before consumption, it is recommended to use a water bath for reheating at 75 °C for 10 min. However, many consumers reflect that after reheating, there will be an unpleasant smell, affecting the quality of food.

pmc-11677354.title: Using Virtual Reality Pablo Gaming in the Post-Operative Rehabilitation of Breast Cancer Patients: Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-11677354.creator: Ahmed Abdelmoniem Ibrahim, Sobhy M. Aly, Ahmed S. A. Youssef, Mohamed Marzouk Mohamed Ragab, Hisham M. Hussein
pmc-11677354.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background/Objectives: Surgical treatment of breast cancer may lead to physical and psychological side effects. Exercises, especially those aided by virtual reality (VR), can improve both physical and psychological dysfunctions. To explore the effects of exercises using VR through Pablo games Technology on the function, grip strength, wrist ROM, fatigue, pain, activities of daily living (ADLs), and anxiety among post-operative breast cancer females.

pmc-11692395.title: PERCEIVED AND ACTUAL BMI IN AGING ADULTS: A SCOPING REVIEW
pmc-11692395.creator: Sarah Hubner, Julie Blaskewicz Boron
pmc-11692395.description: Sustaining a healthy weight across the lifespan is an important aspect of disease prevention and quality of life in aging. Still, approximately 77% of US adults deviate from ideal weight recommendations, contributing to disease and disability. Improving lifestyles is critical to reducing this chronic disease burden.

pmc-12598386.title: Total Synthesis and Analysis of Phenolic Phytoprostanes, Oxidized Derivatives of Lipophenols
pmc-12598386.creator: M. Jordan Lehoux, Ángel Sánchez‐Illana, Pablo Miralles, Valérie Bultel‐Poncé, Thierry Durand, Céline Crauste, Camille Oger
pmc-12598386.description: Lipophenols, or phenolipids, are compounds that combine polyphenols with fatty acids, offering the antioxidant properties of polyphenols alongside the neuroprotective and cardioprotective benefits of omega‐3 polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs). Hydroxytyrosol (HT)‐based lipophenols have recently been identified in olive oil. Depending on their structure, these compounds were differently affected by storage conditions.

pmc-12653290.title: Biosynthesis Regulation of Secondary Metabolite Production in Fusarium Fungi
pmc-12653290.creator: Prosper Amuzu, Xiaoqian Pan, Xuwen Hou, Yu Li, Jiahang Sun, Yujun Huang, Pengfei Wang, Liyao Liu, Daowan Lai, Ligang Zhou
pmc-12653290.description: Fusarium fungi are prolific producers of a wide array of structurally and functionally diverse secondary metabolites (SMs), ranging from harmful mycotoxins to beneficial phytohormones and medicines. Many of these compounds show significant promise for use as agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals and food additives.

pmc-12789416.title: ECG sonification methods for robust and generalizable clinical decision support
pmc-12789416.creator: Mohamed Elgendi, Azza Elkhalifa, Maha Alshehhi, Elyazia Almarri, Kinda Khalaf, Ahsan Khandoker, Rabab Ward
pmc-12789416.description: Electrocardiography (ECG) sonification has emerged as a complementary modality to visual waveform interpretation, enabling diagnostic cues to be conveyed through sound in real time. This review synthesizes evidence from the past decade to establish the current methodological landscape and gaps in ECG sonification research.

pmc-13087036.title: A pipeline leakage detection method for boiler energy operation system using enhanced SVM-based acoustic emission technology
pmc-13087036.creator: Tianlong Yuan, Xiaofei Zhang, Qian Zhang, Minghang Tan
pmc-13087036.description: Pipeline leakage detection in boiler energy systems is essential for operational safety and efficiency, yet conventional techniques such as pressure-based and mass-balance methods often lack real-time performance and sensitivity to small leaks. Although acoustic emission (AE) technology offers dynamic, non-destructive monitoring, its practical application is hindered by noise interference and limited training samples under industrial conditions.

pmc-13124238.title: Persistent postoperative opioid use in patients treated with total hip arthroplasty and hemiarthroplasty for femoral neck fracture: a propensity-score-matched analysis
pmc-13124238.creator: Mina Tohidi, Jensen Murphy, Stephen M Mann, Patti A Groome
pmc-13124238.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background:Pain management after hip fracture surgery is particularly challenging because clinicians must simultaneously minimize prolonged opioid exposure while ensuring effective recovery in this vulnerable patient population. We sought to compare persistent postoperative opioid use across a matched group of patients with femoral neck fracture treated with either total hip arthroplasty (THA) or hemiarthroplasty and to describe the association between patient characteristics and opioid use.Methods:Routinely collected health care databases were linked at ICES to create a population-based cohort of patients aged 66 years

pmc-13135702.title: Enterococcus faecalis biofilm removal efficacy, cytotoxicity and alkaline phosphatase activity on stem cells after the application of conventional medicaments and novel hydrogels used in regenerative endodontics
pmc-13135702.creator: Adem Öztürk, Tuğçe Duran, Ayce Unverdi Eldeniz
pmc-13135702.description: BackgroundTo compare the antibacterial activity of conventional intracanal medicaments used in regenerative endodontic treatment (TAP, DAP, Ca(OH)₂, CHX gel) with novel hydrogel-based formulations (chitosan, CHX, hyaluronic acid, metronidazole, and diclofenac hydrogels) against Enterococcus faecalis biofilms, and to assess their cytotoxic effects on dental pulp stem cells (DPSCs).MethodsAntibacterial activity was evaluated using an E. faecalis biofilm model in single-rooted incisors.

pmc-13430715.title: Investigating the associations between AI-Based educational tool utilization, academic procrastination, academic achievement, and time management among nursing students
pmc-13430715.creator: Zainab Albikawi, Mohammad Abuadas
pmc-13430715.description: BackgroundThe role of artificial intelligence (AI) tools in education has transformed the way students learn and manage their academic tasks. However, health professions education has not sufficiently studied the role of AI tools in procrastination, time management, and academic achievement.ObjectivesTo investigate the associations of AI-based educational tools usage, academic procrastination, academic achievement, and time management among undergraduate nursing students.

pmc-13580441.title: Efficacy and Metabolic Effects of Pegylated Interferon α-2b versus Nucleos(T)ide Analogues in Patients with Chronic Hepatitis B and Concomitant Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease: A Retrospective Study
pmc-13580441.creator: Yaoyu Liu, Hanlong Wang, Xiaoting Zheng, Chunying He, Yizhi Xie, Yan Dai, Huijuan Chen, Zhenhui Liu, Shaodong Chen, Huiqing Liang
pmc-13580441.description: Aim of the StudyCHB and MASLD are increasingly prevalent coexisting conditions that accelerate liver fibrosis progression and increase hepatocellular carcinoma risk. This study aimed to compare the antiviral efficacy and metabolic effects of PEG-IFNα-2b versus nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) in patients with the CHB-MASLD comorbidity.
